meta.title: Muhammad Hanif Fauzi | Portfolio
meta.description: Portfolio of Muhammad Hanif Fauzi, a fullstack developer who builds web applications from start to finish.

hero.intro: I build web applications from start to finish, turning ideas into products that are reliable, easy to use and ready to grow.

about.p1: Hi, I'm Muhammad <hl>Hanif</hl> Fauzi, a fullstack developer based in South Tangerang. I like taking a feature from the first idea all the way to the version people actually use, and I care as much about what runs behind the screen as what shows on it.
about.p2: My path into tech wasn't a straight line. I studied Islamic Family Law, then joined Purwadhika's fullstack bootcamp in 2025 and graduated as Best Student of Batch 33. Today I work at Notch Creative Digital Agency, where I helped rebuild UNICEF Indonesia's donation platform.
about.p3: That journey shaped how I build: begin with something small that works, get the foundations right, and let it grow with the people who use it.
about.quote: Start small, build it right, and let it grow.

skills.intro: The languages, frameworks and tools I use every day to build, ship and look after web applications.

contact.intro: Open to fullstack roles, whether remote, hybrid or on-site, and to collaborations. Email reaches me fastest.
